how: A commit cannot name its own hash. The FREEZE commit lands PREREG.md, screen_lib.py, launch_budget44k.sh, adjudicate_budget44k.py, test_budget44k.py, BAND_CLAIMED.placeholder and selftest_fixture/ with this field reading PENDING; a SECOND, stamping commit replaces it with the freeze commit's 40-hex sha. launch_budget44k.sh REFUSES a real chunk while it still says PENDING, and G-BLIND fails any archive whose manifest does not carry a 40-hex BLIND_COMMIT. --dry-run, --smoke and --smoke-prod are EXEMPT (they play only the disjoint throwaway range and spend no blindness, no band).
what_is_frozen: PREREG.md — the question, the design, the bar and its derivation, the branch ladder, the power tables INCLUDING the null's read distribution, the gates, the ETA, and what each branch licenses
screen_lib.py — the frozen constants, the sourced priors, the branch ladder, the budget/arbiter gates, sanity_check()
adjudicate_budget44k.py — the chunk-pooling adjudicator and the READ_RULE it executes
launch_budget44k.sh — the launcher, its precondition ladder (re-checked before EVERY chunk), and the smoke legs
test_budget44k.py + selftest_fixture/ — the contract tests and the REAL-EMITTER fixtures
BAND_CLAIMED.placeholder — the band is PROPOSED (173e9), not claimed
the_one_discretionary_call: BAR_M = +0.80 pts/deck, derived as r x D_prev = 0.675 x 1.2293 = 0.8298 (PREREG §4.3). PREREG §4.4 prints the read distribution under the alternative +1.00 (the FPU chain's bar class), which discharges a true null materially better (49.6% vs 33.6%) for ~2pp of adopt power. If the owner prefers the bounding direction, change BAR_M BEFORE this field is stamped. Likewise PREREG §3.6 records the counter-case for swapping which cell is the powered primary; that swap is also a pre-stamp change.
